name: Color Match
description: Move a picture's colors to a reference's, so a redrawn region does not show a color shift at its seam. Reinhard (the default) matches the mean and spread of each color axis (Reinhard et al.'s color transfer); Match Color follows Photoshop's Image > Adjustments > Match Color, with Luminance, Color Intensity and Neutralize. With a mask, the colors are measured only where the mask is 0: the part that was kept.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.description: How much of the match to apply: the fade between the picture and the result.

inputs.name: method
inputs.label: Method
inputs.description: Reinhard: mean and spread of each color axis. Match Color: Photoshop's Match Color in CIELAB, with the three sliders below.

inputs.name: luminance
inputs.label: Luminance
inputs.description: Match Color only. How far the brightness is moved to the reference's: 1 matches it, 0 keeps the mean flat, 2 doubles the effect.

inputs.name: color_intensity
inputs.label: Color intensity
inputs.description: Match Color only. How colorful the result is against the reference: 1 matches it, 0 is gray, 2 is twice as colorful.

inputs.name: neutralize
inputs.label: Neutralize
inputs.description: Match Color only. Takes this fraction of the picture's own color cast off before matching.
